title: Personalization Human Relevance Pilot 01 session response
description: Schema only. No participant or response records are included. Human collection is not authorized by this artifact.

sessionCode.description: Cryptographically random study code; must not encode or map to direct identity.

sessionManifestHash.description: SHA-256 of the frozen per-session receipt binding profile-seed references, both arm compositions, renderer, assignment, and scenario order.

declaredContextTags.description: Optional codes from an owner-approved coarse topic vocabulary; do not store sensitive free text here.

studyOnlyPreferenceSeedKeys.description: Optional keys for public frozen sample items the participant chose as study-only save/star examples; never Miniflux IDs.

overallPreference.description: One final paired choice; null means unanswered, CANNOT_JUDGE is an explicit response.

allocationKey.description: Random join key into a separately restricted allocation/mapping file; contains no arm identity itself.

optionalRationale.description: Optional short comment; participants are instructed not to include identifying or sensitive personal information. Review/redact before analysis.

oneOf.description: Skipped or unanswered; distinct from the explicit CANNOT_JUDGE response.

pairReceiptHash.description: SHA-256 of the frozen X/Y pair output and integrity metadata for this scenario.

scenarioPreference.description: Preference for this scenario only. Null means omitted; CANNOT_JUDGE is an explicit response.
